Trash Wheel Collection Data

trash_collections.Rd

Data on rubbish collected by four Trash Wheels operating in Baltimore's waterways.

Usage

trash_collections

Format

A data frame with 6,951 rows and 11 variables:

id

Trash wheel identifier

name

Trash Wheel name

dumpster

Dumpster collection number

month

Month of collection

year

Year of collection

date

Date of collection

weight

Height collected in US tonnes

volume

Volume collected in cubic yards

homes_powered

Estimated number of homes that could be powered using energy from the rubbish

trash_type

Category of rubbish collected

count

Estimated number of items collected

Source

TidyTuesday, https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/main/data/2024/2024-03-05/readme.md Baltimore's Healthy Harbor initiative, https://www.mrtrashwheel.com/

Details

Each row represents one rubbish category recorded for one dumpster collection. Item counts are estimates rather than estimates rather than exact counts. Missing counts do not mean zero rubbish.
